title: Kissed British Steak Toast
description: Floral, fluffy, light British dish featuring fillet of steak, toast, nut‑free‑friendly.
instructions: Season the fillet with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper on both sides.
Heat a skillet over high heat and melt the unsalted butter, then add the fresh rosemary and a small pinch of dried lavender.
Sear the seasoned steak for about two minutes per side until a golden crust forms, then transfer it to a warm plate to rest.
While the steak rests, toast the sourdough slices in the same skillet until golden, brushing them lightly with melted butter.
Spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard on each toasted slice, then drizzle with honey and sprinkle lemon zest.
Slice the rested steak into thin strips and arrange them over the prepared toast.
Finish by sprinkling additional fresh rosemary and a dash of dried lavender over the steak.
Serve immediately, optionally pairing with a small splash of white wine on the side.
